dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报；仅演示已核实的天文专名用法
dual_scenarios.ms: Helene ialah sebuah satelit semula jadi Zuhal yang berkongsi orbit dengan Dione.
dual_scenarios.zh: Helene 是土星的一颗天然卫星，与 Dione 共用轨道。
dual_scenarios.en: Helene is a natural satellite of Saturn that shares its orbit with Dione.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah tengok gambar Helene kat laman NASA. Bentuknya tak bulat macam yang aku sangka.

etymology.historical_story: The supplied token has no definition or identifying context, so its own origin remains unresolved. One documented namesake is Saturn's moon Helene, discovered in 1980. NASA explains that the moon was named after the Greek mythological figure associated with the Trojan War. That naming history belongs specifically to the astronomical object and must not be assigned automatically to every occurrence of helene. [NASA: Helene](https://science.nasa.gov/saturn/moons/helene/)
